# EGIRE Robotics

> EGIRE Robotics is an Indian FPV drone, AI and robotics training company. It runs FPV piloting workshops, drone building courses, simulator training and a 90-day course for students, colleges and professionals across India, and supplies drone spares.

Website: https://www.egirerobotics.com
Email: contact@egirerobotics.com
Phone: +91 8500126104 (WhatsApp +91 9110566354)

## Training and workshops
- [Workshops for colleges](https://www.egirerobotics.com/workshops): 7-day FPV piloting workshop, drone building, certificates, fees from Rs 7,999
- [Enquire or book a demo](https://www.egirerobotics.com/enquire)
- [About EGIRE Robotics](https://www.egirerobotics.com/about)

## Academy (free with sign-in)
FPV piloting, PID tuning, drone hardware, drone physics, wiring lab and a drone configurator, taught with interactive 3D lessons.
